listing.name: Fight Night Round 3 — Fight Night Round 3 Recomp (djultra64)
listing.summary: Upstream advertises 60 FPS gameplay. Intermittent loading, text and audio defects remain; Portcove has not confirmed performance. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own supported USA Fight Night Round 3 Xbox 360 ISO. This guide does not include its required hashes; compare your files with the upstream first-launch guide before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Choose the v1.0.2 Linux or Windows runtime package. On first launch, follow the game’s checks and import your own supported USA ISO.

warnings: Upstream advertises 60 FPS gameplay. Intermittent loading, text and audio defects remain; Portcove has not confirmed performance.
